# gramlot-examples 0.3.24

Consolidates the gallery, shorter teaching examples, shared environment collections and feature index. Grid lessons cover resident viewport rendering, floating workspaces, database customers, typed JSONL and Asqueel cached selections; generic capabilities and Asqueel-only capabilities are identified separately.

The database demonstrations require their documented server and database configuration. Invoice-row datasets are examples; the Invoice application is excluded. Experimental selections are labelled and do not claim a final dataSelection API. Remote Edit remains disabled in the public profile.
